summary: Several new cases are before the Jamestown justice courts. In Judge Hamilton's court, Mr. Silver's case against Thos. Thompson over a pair of oxen ends with the defendant discharged after sharp legal argument, while Pat Murphy's wage claim against D. M. Kelleher is continued; in Judge McMillan's court, P. Aubertin's claim against Mr. McClure and Frank Colby's suit against George and Morris Creps for cutting his hay are both on the docket. A follow-up reports that Pat Murphy wins judgment for one hundred dollars against the War Horse, with Mr. Camp as his attorney.
